name: Alamosa (Alavesa del Motor, S.A.)
note: Rating note: Alavesa del Motor, S.A. (Alamosa) is a family car-parts retailer founded in Vitoria-Gasteiz; its website says it belongs to the DP distribution group and Dipart says it joined Dipart in 2013. Back-of-shorts sponsor of Kosner Baskonia from 2026-27 to 2029-30 (Liga Endesa games). No source states who owns Alavesa del Motor, S.A. No record of serious abuse was found. Proposed 'Nothing found'; a maintainer sets the tier.
